title: GRAHAM MERCER // WEEK 5 DAILY MARKET COMPARISON
purpose: Preserve one auditable Graham-vs-Pinnacle spread comparison for each active Week 5 matchup on each review day without allowing the market to overwrite Graham's independently built fair number.

marketBenchmark.substitutionRule: If Pinnacle is unavailable, record PINNACLE_UNAVAILABLE for that capture. Do not silently substitute Bet365, DraftKings, consensus, or another book.

capturePolicy.dailyReviewRule: From the Tuesday weekly baseline until each game's kickoff, preserve a daily comparison after Graham's independent number for that day is finalized.
capturePolicy.gameDayRule: A game-day capture is allowed and should be separately timestamped. A later capture never overwrites an earlier daily snapshot.
capturePolicy.closeRule: When available, preserve the final pre-kickoff Pinnacle spread as a distinct CLOSE snapshot for later calibration.
capturePolicy.marketIsolationRule: Graham's fair number must be completed before the Pinnacle field is exposed to the comparison step.
capturePolicy.noMoveRule: If Graham's number does not change, still preserve the day's comparison so market movement can be measured against a stable Graham number.
capturePolicy.missedCaptureRule: If an expected daily snapshot was missed, OddsPapi historical odds may be used to backfill only when the recovered Pinnacle observation can be timestamped and clearly marked BACKFILL.
capturePolicy.immutabilityRule: Snapshots are append-only. Correct errors by appending a CORRECTION event referencing the bad sequence; do not rewrite prior daily observations.

signConvention.grahamFairHome: Negative means home favorite; positive means home underdog.
signConvention.pinnacleSpreadHome: Negative means home favorite; positive means home underdog.
signConvention.grahamHomeStrengthGap: pinnacleSpreadHome - grahamFairHome. Positive means Graham rates the home team stronger than Pinnacle by that many points; negative means Graham rates the away team stronger.
